categories.label: Track sections in completed links

categories.label: Shares issued
categories.hint: -3 VP per share on the Issued Share Track (max 15).

tiebreakers.description: Tie rule not verified; victory treated as shared.
tiebreakers.descriptionVi: Luật hòa chưa xác minh; coi như cùng thắng.

notes: family: auction-money. Game length depends on player count (Turn Track). Money has no value at the end. A player whose income would drop below 0 is eliminated and cannot win; score only surviving players. Tiebreaker not confirmed (rules reference Ill. 17). Official rulebook PDF not retrievable; verified against a rules transcription only.
uiHintReason: Three direct reads: income level, completed track sections, shares issued.
winConditionVi: Điểm cao nhất thắng; người chơi bị loại (thu nhập âm) không thể thắng. Điểm = 3 x thu nhập + đoạn đường hoàn chỉnh - 3 x cổ phiếu phát hành.
